sighs.hears: The sighs in D major: the oboe and clarinets' sighing figure 0.3-30 s (Bb4/E5, G5-F#5-E5-D5-C#5, the repeated D5s), one note per sigh.

sigh-chords.hears: The muted strings' rocking chords under the sighs, 0-22.5 s (each chord's outer voices).

love-theme.hears: The love theme in the violins, notes held >= 0.4 s: its swell 22.5-37.6 s and its ecstatic ff statement 37.6-95 s (A5, D6, E6, B5 ... up to G6 at 51.9 s).

love-climax-onsets.hears: The love theme's stressed beats from the audio, 37.6-95 s (onset strength >= 0.8): the pulse of the ecstatic statement, each with its notes.

broken-theme.hears: The theme breaking off and the feud stirring, 95-117.8 s: the string line (notes held >= 0.28 s).

feud-accents.hears: The feud's accented attacks: audio onsets of strength >= 0.9, 117.8-202.7 s, each with its notes (outer voices).

feud-runs.hears: The scurrying string runs (5+ stepwise notes <= 0.2 s apart): the feud's machinery, mostly 117-202 s.

clash-strokes.hears: The sword clashes: cymbal-bright strokes from the audio (5-11 kHz jump >= 9 dB to -20 dB or louder), 139.7-202.1 s; each the top note struck with it, else octave 6.

ff-blows.hears: The real ff blows of the catastrophe: audio onsets of strength >= 1.4 at -25 dB or louder (139.8-212.6 s), each with its notes.

catastrophe-blows.hears: The last blows: low-band strokes 195-213 s (210.0, 212.4 ...) and the held-blow chords, from the audio; each the lowest note struck, else octave 2.

violins.hears: The violins' line, notes held >= 0.28 s, the whole pack.

harp.hears: The harp (the roll's "plucked" and "piano" tracks): harp arpeggios by ear and register (the labels are the transcriber's), inside the love theme 39-95 s and the catastrophe.

dying-roll.hears: Hole cover for the end, from the audio: the held F# under the timpani roll, 212.6-219.5 s, as held notes at each change (octave 2).

melody.hears: The voiced-out top line of the whole pack: every instrument, notes held >= 0.28 s at G3 or higher, the top (or the clearly loudest) note of each attack; a note under a higher one still sounding is hidden.

bass-line.hears: The bass line: the lowest note of each attack below D3 (cellos, basses, bassoons; roll and pack), one per 0.25 s.

chord-blocks.hears: Chord blocks: attacks of 5+ notes (roll and pack), thinned to their outer voices, one attack per chord.

winds-line.hears: Every woodwind and horn voice's line: the top of each wind attack held >= 0.28 s, the whole pack.
